title: El novenario
desc: Nine nights in somebody else’s house
setting: A neighbour has died. Lucía tells you the rosary is at seven and that you are going every night.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.en: Are you going to come every night?

options.es: Sí. ¿Qué se hace, solo estar ahí?
options.en: Yes. What does one do, just be there?
options.feedback: The yes came first and the question second. That order is the whole thing.

options.es: Voy a ir hoy por lo menos.
options.en: I will go today at least.
options.feedback: Going once is better than not going. Everybody counts the nights.
Nobody is there because they knew him. They are there because the family is.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: Estar ahí. Y llevá algo para el café.
steps.en: Be there. And take something for the coffee.

options.es: Va. Llevo azúcar y pan, ¿está bien?
options.en: Right. I will take sugar and bread, is that all right?
options.feedback: Named the thing and checked. Nine nights of coffee is a real cost to that house and this is how it gets shared.

options.en: All right, I will take something.
options.feedback: Fine. Naming it means nobody ends up with four bags of sugar.

options.en: Do you have to take something?
options.feedback: She has just said so. Asking again sounds like looking for a way out.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: Y no hablés mucho. Ahí se está callado.
steps.en: And do not talk much. There you stay quiet.

options.es: Entendido. Yo saludo y me quedo atrás.
options.en: Understood. I will greet people and stay at the back.
options.feedback: You took the instruction and turned it into a plan. That is somebody who has understood what a wake is for.

options.es: Está bien, voy a estar callado.
options.en: All right, I will be quiet.
options.feedback: Correct. Quiet is not the same as absent, and the greeting matters.

options.en: And what does one talk about then?
options.feedback: Nothing. That is the answer, and asking makes the silence sound like a problem.

steps.speaker: Lucía
steps.es: La novena noche es distinta. Esa es más grande.
steps.en: The ninth night is different. That one is bigger.

options.es: Entonces esa noche pido permiso en el trabajo.
options.en: Then that night I will ask for time off work.
options.feedback: Nobody asked you to. Doing it without being asked is what gets remembered in that family for years.

options.en: I will be there for that one too.
options.feedback: A promise, and a good one. Saying how you will manage it makes it real.
It is. Everybody in that house knows exactly how many it is.
